app.unverifiedBannerBody: You can sign in and explore the platform, but you can only submit material requests after an administrator has approved your account.

verifiedRoute.title: Account not yet verified
verifiedRoute.body: Your account already exists, but it has not yet been approved by an administrator. Until then, you can only browse the materials.

cart.successBody: Your request was submitted successfully. You will receive a confirmation by email.
cart.emptyBody: Browse our materials and add items to your cart.
cart.title: Cart
cart.loginPrompt: Please sign in to submit a request.

requestForm.plannedStudentsHelp: This information is optional. It helps us process your request appropriately.
requestForm.shareStudents: I consent to sending the planned number of students for processing my request.
requestForm.doNotShareStudents: I do not want to send the planned number of students. In that case, the value 0 will be sent.
requestForm.studentsNotUsed: In that case, the student count is not used and will be sent as 0.
requestForm.privacyBody: When you submit your request, the personal data entered in this form is processed for reviewing, handling, fulfilling, and documenting your request. This includes in particular contact, delivery, and request data.
requestForm.privacyConsent: I confirm that my information may be processed for these purposes so that my request can be handled and fulfilled.

errors.notLoggedIn: You must be signed in to send a request.
errors.privacyRequired: Please confirm the processing of your information to handle the request.
errors.invalidStudents: Please enter a valid planned number of students.
errors.deliveryTooSoon: The delivery date must be at least 3 days in the future.
errors.generic: An error occurred. Please try again.

myRequests.cancelError: The request could not be cancelled

myRequests.emptyActiveBody: You can find your archived requests below.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The requested page does not exist.

help.title: Help & guide
help.intro: Welcome to EHALP. Here you can find a step-by-step guide for using the platform.
help.contactBody: For technical issues or further questions, send an email to peselis20100@gmail.com.

browse.title: Browse materials
browse.intro: On the "Browse materials" page you will find all available first-aid training materials.
browse.item1Text: Use the checkboxes in the sidebar to filter by categories such as "Resuscitation", "Wound care & trauma", or "Accessories".
browse.item2Text: Use the search field at the top to look for specific materials.
browse.item3Text: Click a material to see more information.

cart.title: Add items to the cart
cart.intro: Add the materials you need to your cart.
cart.item3Text: The current number of items is shown in the header.

submit.title: Submit a request
submit.intro: In the cart you can create and submit your request.
submit.item1Text: Change quantities directly in the cart or remove items.
submit.item3Text: Specify when you can return the materials.
submit.item4Text: Enter the number of participating students.
submit.item6Text: Click "Send request" to submit the request.

after.title: After submission
after.intro: What happens after you submit your request?
after.item1Text: You will receive a confirmation by email.
after.item2Text: Your request is reviewed by the organization.
after.item3Text: After approval, the materials are prepared for shipping.
after.item4Text: The materials are shipped to the specified address.

status.title: Track request status
status.intro: Under "My requests" you can view all your requests.
status.item1Text: See the current status of each request.
status.item3Text: Click a request to view all details.

cancel.title: Cancel a request
cancel.intro: You can cancel a request as long as it has not been shipped yet.
cancel.item2Text: For pending or approved requests, you will find a cancel button.
